front: Mon ordinateur portable ne s'allume plus.
back: My laptop won't turn on anymore.
context: 'S'allumer' = to turn on (by itself); 'allumer' = to switch something on.

front: Tu as essayé de le redémarrer ?
back: Have you tried restarting it?
context: 'Redémarrer' = to restart. The universal first tech-support question.

front: L'écran est tout noir.
back: The screen is completely black.

front: Mon téléphone a planté.
back: My phone crashed.

front: Le clavier français est différent du clavier anglais.
pronunciation: [luh klah-vyay frahn-SEH eh dee-fay-rahn dü klah-vyay ahn-GLEH]
back: The French keyboard is different from the English one.
context: French keyboards are AZERTY, not QWERTY: the A and Q, Z and W are swapped.

front: Comment on tape un accent sur ce clavier ?
pronunciation: [koh-mahn ohn tap an nak-SAHN sür suh klah-VYAY]
back: How do you type an accent on this keyboard?

front: Il faut brancher le chargeur.
back: You need to plug in the charger.

front: J'ai perdu tous mes fichiers.
back: I lost all my files.
context: 'Un fichier' = a file; 'un dossier' = a folder.

front: Tu as fait une sauvegarde ?
back: Did you make a backup?

front: N'oublie pas d'enregistrer ton document.
back: Don't forget to save your document.

front: Clique sur l'icône en haut à droite.
pronunciation: [kleek sür lee-KOHN ahn oh ah DRWAHT]
back: Click on the icon in the top right.

front: Copie-colle le texte dans un mail.
back: Copy and paste the text into an email.

front: L'imprimante n'a plus d'encre.
back: The printer is out of ink.

front: Il y a un bug dans l'application.
back: There's a bug in the app.

front: Mon ordinateur est très lent depuis la mise à jour.
pronunciation: [mohn nor-dee-nah-tuhr eh treh LAHN duh-pwee lah meez ah ZHOOR]
back: My computer has been very slow since the update.

front: Le disque dur est plein.
back: The hard drive is full.
context: 'Le disque dur' = hard drive. 'L'espace de stockage' = storage.

front: Je stocke mes photos dans le cloud.
pronunciation: [zhuh stok may foh-TOH dahn luh KLOWD]
back: I store my photos in the cloud.

front: Tu as une clé USB ?
back: Do you have a USB stick?
context: USB is read letter by letter in French: [ü-es-BAY].

front: Mes écouteurs sans fil ne se connectent pas.
pronunciation: [may zay-koo-TUHR sahn FEEL nuh suh koh-NEKT pah]
back: My wireless earbuds won't connect.
context: 'Sans fil' = wireless. 'Le Bluetooth' is pronounced roughly [bloo-TOOS].

front: J'ai fait tomber mon téléphone et l'écran est fissuré.
pronunciation: [zhay feh tohm-bay mohn tay-lay-FUN ay lay-krahn eh fee-sü-RAY]
back: I dropped my phone and the screen is cracked.

front: Combien ça coûte de faire réparer l'écran ?
pronunciation: [kohm-byan sah koot duh fehr ray-pah-ray lay-KRAHN]
back: How much does it cost to get the screen repaired?

front: Le téléphone est encore sous garantie.
back: The phone is still under warranty.

front: Il faut installer la nouvelle version du logiciel.
pronunciation: [eel foh tan-stah-lay lah noo-vel vehr-syohn dü loh-zhee-SYEL]
back: You need to install the new version of the software.

front: J'ai reçu un mail bizarre, c'est sûrement une arnaque.
pronunciation: [zhay ruh-SÜ an mel bee-ZAR, seh sür-mahn tün ar-NAK]
back: I got a strange email, it's probably a scam.

front: Ne clique jamais sur les liens suspects.
pronunciation: [nuh kleek zhah-meh sür lay lyan sü-SPEH]
back: Never click on suspicious links.

front: Il faut activer la double authentification.
back: You should enable two-factor authentication.

front: Je ne sais pas me servir de ce logiciel.
pronunciation: [zhuh nuh seh pah muh sehr-veer duh suh loh-zhee-SYEL]
back: I don't know how to use this software.
context: 'Se servir de' = to use. 'Utiliser' is also fine.

front: Tu peux m'expliquer comment ça marche ?
back: Can you explain to me how it works?

front: Le service client ne répond jamais.
back: Customer service never answers.
context: 'Le service client' = customer service; 'le SAV' (service après-vente) = after-sales service.

front: J'ai commandé une tablette en ligne.
back: I ordered a tablet online.

front: Le colis devrait arriver dans trois jours.
pronunciation: [luh koh-LEE duh-vreh ah-ree-vay dahn trwah ZHOOR]
back: The parcel should arrive in three days.

front: Mon ordinateur fait un bruit bizarre.
back: My computer is making a strange noise.
context: 'Faire un bruit' = to make a noise.

front: Il faudrait changer la batterie.
back: The battery should be replaced.
context: 'Il faudrait' (conditional of falloir) = it would be necessary to.

front: Ces nouvelles lunettes connectées sont trop chères pour moi.
pronunciation: [say noo-vel lü-net koh-nek-TAY sohn troh SHEHR poor MWAH]
back: These new smart glasses are too expensive for me.

front: La technologie évolue tellement vite !
back: Technology changes so fast!
